What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use. The coverage period depends on the item:
Wax warmers purchased before March 20, 2026: one year from purchase.
Wax warmers purchased on or after March 20, 2026: six months from purchase. Registering the warmer within 60 days makes it eligible for a free two-year limited warranty.
Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.
Silicone dishes: six months from purchase.
During the initial warranty period, manufacturer-defective products or parts are replaced at no charge. During the extended limited warranty period, replacements for manufacturer defects are offered at a 50% discount. The warranty doesn’t cover accidental damage, abuse, neglect, incorrect voltage or power supply, attempted repairs, loss, or theft.
You can read more on our Shipping, Warranty, & Returns page. If you have a defective item, tell me which item it is and what’s happening, and I’ll help with the next step.
